scientific_integrity: Exact derivative identity and uniform oscillatory-integral bounds supply the proof; finite computer diagnostics do not replace the analytic argument. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed harmonic degrees only; the q=4 individual moments diverge and are compared via convergent differences. No global nonconstant stability-mode classification or all-q ordering is claimed. Classical special-function literature might already imply the finite-aperture antiderivative.
title: Critical fourth-moment Bessel staircase and the square-root Fourier modal gap
